name: std::unordered_map<Key,T,Hash,KeyEqual,Allocator>::~unordered_map
intro:
A destructor. 
Destructs the unordered_map. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated. Note, that if the elements are pointers, the pointed-to objects are not destroyed.

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Linear in the size of the unordered_map.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Insert keys 2, 3, and 4, then inspect the bucket holding key 2. Bucket counts and iteration order are implementation-dependent.
